summary: Morgan Stanley Solana Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that Craig Abruzzo assumed the role of Co-Chief Operating Officer of Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc., the Trust's delegated sponsor, and was appointed a director of the sponsor effective October 1, 2026. The filing is a routine governance disclosure for a non-executive sponsor appointment; it involves no stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, financing, or regulatory clock. No transaction mechanics or ownership changes are implicated, and there is no deal to trade or risk-arb consideration.
